output.brief: The pipeline surge is not real buying activity. On 29 Sept at about 23:14, an import job run under Jun Okafor's login created 212 partner-tagged records worth $6.2M. None has any logged call, email or meeting. 171 of them copy old closed-lost deals from 2024, with the close date moved to Q4. Reps created only about $0.7M of new pipeline in those three days. Rep-created pipeline was flat at about $8.4M, and rep win rates held steady at 23–25%. The four reps Dana wants to discipline have normal win rates, and they were assigned 129 of the imported records. The webinars produced only 11 opportunities worth $0.46M. The $5.9M "influenced" figure is mostly the imported records. Without the import, coverage is about 1.9x, below the 3.0x hiring threshold. I'm confident in all of this except one point. We don't know who prepared the import file. Dana's 28 Sept email pressed for deals before the snapshot, but she denies preparing the file. Next steps: don't start the performance plans, don't release the requisitions, and don't remove Dana yet. Quarantine the 212 records and restate coverage. Tell the hiring committee. Preserve the import file and job record, then interview Okafor and the channel members to find out who prepared and requested the file. Hold the webinar expansion until it is re-measured on a fair basis.
